news.title: Gianni Infantino: Fifa president says he is backed by 'vast majority' in world football
news.lede: Infantino laughs off resignation questions. Fifa president Gianni Infantino insists he has the backing of the "vast, vast majority" of world football, as he laughed off questions about whether he had considered resigning over the World Cup sell-off debacle. In a rare interview, he struck a defiant tone to BBC Sport about his own position in the wake of the controversial Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal, and said it was not always easy to bring different points of view "under one roof". "There is nothing bad in disagreeing," he said.

news.title: PH debuts in FIFA U15 World Cup vs Morocco
news.lede: BAKU – The Philippine Under-15 Men’s National Football Team (PMNFT U15) debuted in the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival, 0-2, versus African power Morocco at Pitch 7B of the Hövsan Competition Complex. The tournament is the first global competition FIFA has held in the 8v8 format. It brings together the youth national teams of 189 member associations from six confederations, making it the largest FIFA tournament ever in terms of participation. It gives young players from many countries a chance to meet and to show the different ways the game is played around the world.

news.title: FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival: India begins campaign with 4-2 win over Laos
news.lede: AIFF media AIFF media https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/ftuud/article71619483.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/india%20real%20world%20cup.png Chennai Macdonnish Ngairangbam opened the scoring for the Blue Colts in the seventh minute before R Lalremruatfela doubled their adavantage in the 11th minute. India began its FIFA Under-15 World Cup campaign with a 4-2 win over Laos in Azerbaijan on Saturday. Bibiano Fernandes’ Blue Colts made a bright start on Saturday morning and created two chances in the opening four minutes. A powerful left-footed effort from inside the box by Deepak Singh Arambam was pushed away by the Laos goalkeeper Anousith Souksavanh in the third minute, before Macdonnish was denied by the advancing custodian a minute later.

news.title: Ronaldinho's surprise return to football with Italian club Ravenna
news.lede: Brazils football icon Ronaldinho, a World Cup winner and Ballon dOr recipient, is set to make a sensational return to competitive football at the age of 46, joining Italian third-tier club Ravenna for a match against Forli on November 15. IMAGE: Ravenna signed Ronaldinho in June and he later acquired a stake in the club, which is owned by his friend Ignazio Cipriani. Photograph: Ciro De Luca/ReutersKey PointsBrazil legend Ronaldinho, 46, will return to competitive football on November 15 for Italian third-tier side Ravenna.He will play against local rivals Forli, marking his first competitive match since 2015. Ronaldinho, who officially retired in 2018, won the 2002 World Cup and the 2005 Ballon dOr.He acquired a stake in Ravenna, owned by his friend Ignazio Cipriani, with the aim of engaging the city with the team.
